description: Interconnect production items on a live event — link an item to others across the graph (task→project, project→teams/places/milestones, vendor→projects, programming→talent/places, inventory→team/place/project, receipt/transaction→team/vendor/project, place→parent, cue→place/programming/talent, milestone→projects/tasks, meal→shift, task→place, team→depends_on, buildUnit→unit_lead/unit_team/environments/build_tasks, scholarship→applicant, invitation→nominated_by/applicant, person↔person via modes→roommates/buddy/mentor/significant_other/sharing_vehicle_with/paying_for/ticket_sending_to/ticket_receiving_from). op add/remove/set. name: link_production_items
